title: LSC 6.5.0 exact finite-dilation scientific model
description: LSC 6.5.0 is the exact finite-dilation successor in the established LSC model lineage. It uses one frozen universal alpha_0 in the capture-cross-section energy argument and is executable, audited, and reproducible. The historical 6.3.0 identity is preserved; 6.3.1 was abandoned before release, and the 6.4.0 linear development attempt remains an adverse result. Phase 1 is complete. Development and parameter determination were retrospective and non-blind; experimental Phase 2 validation has not begun. BEST-2 remains future-only and blind, with no prediction generated. The separate LSC Validation Kernel 0.6.0 companion is maintained in the public GitHub repository.
